same HLS assertions on frozen main
package strict tsc and focused eslint
three format build, ESM factory and docs/dist parity
seven browser specs on final built main

iterations: Old baseline expanded from 27 assertions (5 pass/22 fail) to 43 (11 pass/32 fail).
Stable media pairing and superseded error recovery reproduced on intermediate candidate; focused failing logs preserved.
First browser run: two assertions read zero readiness counts before async decoder completion. Wait for the same exact sequence within the original expect timeout.
Second browser run: a poll dereferenced the documented stale-state null. Wait for the non-null selected target; no assertion or timeout widening.
Final strict checking required an explicit PlaybackMedia|null annotation in the resolver loop. Rebuild verified byte-identical main against all 108 browser hashes; final artifact node checks rerun.
limitations: Twenty real HLS UI cases cover two actual cores with native parsing/decoding and controlled query timing, not installed package or physical-device acceptance.
Twenty-nine total Windows WebKit capability controls are not playback and make no general Safari claim.
Already-started replacement work remains owned by Playback until a new replacement begins; a new query is not claimed to synchronously cancel SDK decoding.
Long-run AV sync and full core/proxy/plugin combinations remain MB-09.
Codec capability/fallback and public factory/shim type boundaries remain MB-08 and MB-CAP-01/MB-READY-01.
Installed package/demo and MPL/source-notice gates remain MB-10. No npm release acceptance is implied.
